# Shared-build must run from the manifest source tree

<a id="body"></a>

## Body

shared-build derives its artifact-owner stamp and crate-root touch set from the current Git worktree, or cwd outside Git (harness/scripts/shared-build.sh). --manifest-path does not change that owner. Running from the review checkout against a separate archived source tree let another branch replace core artifacts between mutant runs; the next mutant failed to compile against a foreign Queue trait. That compile failure was not counted as killed. Run just shared-build from the actual source directory, with the same resolved shared target. The corrected #311 replay killed all six intended guard mutants and restored a 16/16 baseline. Always restore source bytes and refresh mtime, and distinguish assertion failures from invalid compilation.
